scope: Independent static review of fresh-computer inference wrapper and lightweight validation of both packaged selected checkpoints; no model inference in this wrapper check.
checks: All subprocess paths resolve relative to package directory and current Python interpreter.
DINO uses evaluate_tta --split test --views original with local pretrained and selected suffix state.
ConvNeXt uses --stage predict --method finetune with explicit data, source split, hashes, pretrained and saved trained checkpoint.
No download or fitting code is called by the wrapper; offline environment flags are set for subprocesses.
Both component CLI interfaces and receipt field names match the current bundled scripts.
DINO full-state/head/suffix hashes agree with saved metrics and portable checkpoint packaging.
ConvNeXt final portable artifact passes the actual wrapper validator, including full model-state hash, selected epoch, suffix hash, official pretrained origin and checkpoint packaging.
Canonical provider order and exact 10001-19879 test ID order are verified before averaging.
Float32 weighted probability arithmetic matches the declared blend; output is checked against probability argmax.
cross_hardware_note: The wrapper records whether its CSV SHA matches reference_submission_sha256 when provided; BF16 results may vary across hardware/library builds.
